title: Parity from negative coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $x\\in\\{ -1,1\\}^n$. The parity function associated to $S$, evaluated at $x$, equals $(-1)^m$, where $m$ is the number of coordinates in $S$ at which $x$ equals $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector on the $n$ coordinates
